flags.why: The entry omits the common meanings of releasing goods for use and exporting goods, both distinct from paying money ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-xu%E1%BA%A5t)).
flags.fix: Add meanings: to issue or release (goods from stock); to export (goods).

flags.why: Cồn denotes a mound or hillock, not a mountain ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%E1%BB%93n)).
Bỏng meaning burnt or scalded is standard Vietnamese used nationwide, not restricted to Northern speech.
The pin sense refers to a skittle or bowling pin, not a pin fastened to clothing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ki)).
flags.fix: Quả bóng làm đổ cả mười ki. = The ball knocked down all ten bowling pins.

flags.why: Irradiance is a measure of radiant power per unit area, whereas bức xạ means radiation itself.
